# Md Shamsuddin

> Digital product designer from Bangladesh with 10 years of experience, mostly with startups. Head of Design at Shifl Inc. Designs products that are easy to use and good for business.

Everything on https://heyshams.com/ is in the HTML of a single page. Each section has an id you can link to: #intro, #works, #shifl, #pathao, #boost, #contact.

## Work

- [Shifl customer portal](https://heyshams.com/#shifl): Led the design of a customer portal that puts shipment updates and key services in one place. Cut unnecessary emails and calls by 15% and reduced errors.
- [Pathao home screen](https://heyshams.com/#pathao): Redesigned the super app's home screen with clearer navigation, small moments of delight and better accessibility. Improved cross-selling and retention.
- [Boost merchant portal](https://heyshams.com/#boost): Rebuilt the information architecture and UI library. Merchants worked faster, satisfaction went up, and more merchants became paying customers.
